review.readiness_note: Visual sign-off at 1440×900. The supplied Lab capture is Business Home, not a matching Business Profile, so this approves the system transfer rather than a pixel-identical layout. The capture establishes that functionality remains exposed; it cannot verify routing, mutations or whether the gear actually opens Settings.
review.why: The production screen carries the Lab’s shell, mineral/graphite palette, typography hierarchy, restrained borders and disciplined accent placement into an appropriate identity-and-management layout. The cover is identifiable and unobstructed, while the business facts and operational rows remain stable, flat and easy to scan. There is no reason to force a Recreate-style commitment joint onto ordinary management rows. Cobalt remains concentrated on navigation selection rather than repeated secondary links. Counts reconcile visibly across sections: 7 campaigns, 4 awaiting a decision and no scheduled content. Status words accompany color, and the approved brand colors remain clearly scoped to the Brand kit. No clipping, overlap or visible loss of navigation appears at this viewport. No monetary amount is displayed, so money typography and financial-detail behavior cannot be assessed here.
review.verdict: Yes—Frame Shift was faithfully transferred at this desktop viewport, with the business’s real identity, states and management actions visibly preserved and no release-blocking visual drift.
